overview: TRIFED Schemes for Tribal Enterprises aim to promote tribal entrepreneurship by transforming Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs) into Van Dhan Producer Enterprises (VDPEs) through capacity building, market access, and financial support. The schemes focus on value addition of Minor Forest Produce (MFP), sustainable livelihood generation, and integration of tribal communities into formal economic systems. TRIFED acts as the nodal agency under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India, implementing initiatives like Van Dhan Yojana, PTP-NER, and Tech for Tribals to enhance tribal income and economic resilience.
objectives: Promote sustainable livelihood systems for tribal people through marketing development and remunerative pricing
Empower tribal producers to embrace entrepreneurship as a way of life
Strengthen tribal value chains by transforming VDVKs into legally registered Van Dhan Producer Enterprises (VDPEs)
Enhance market access through institutional partnerships, exhibitions, and e-commerce platforms
Provide capacity building and skill upgradation via collaborations with IITs, TISS, and other reputed institutions
Ensure socio-economic empowerment through collective processing, value addition, and marketing of forest and farm products
Facilitate access to institutional finance and scale operations for tribal enterprises
Promote tribal products in domestic and international markets through brand development and strategic alliances
eligibility: Tribal individuals, Self Help Groups (SHGs), Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs), and tribal producer groups engaged in Minor Forest Produce (MFP) collection, value addition, and marketing under the Van Dhan Yojana or Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Vikas Yojana (PMVDY) are eligible. VDPEs require federation of four or more geographically proximate VDVKs, with relaxation possible based on feasibility and justification reviewed by TRIFED.
benefits: Benefits include capacity building and training programs (e.g., Tech for Tribal with 120 sessions), market access through TRIBES India retail outlets and exhibitions, financial support for equipment and infrastructure, brand development under 'Tribes India', access to e-commerce platforms, participation in national and international fairs, skill upgradation, and institutional support for legal registration and governance of Van Dhan Producer Enterprises (VDPEs).
financial_support: Financial support is provided through a three-tranche fund release model: 10% upon proposal approval for initiation activities, 40% upon submission of Utilization Certificate and Detailed Project Report for capacity building and infrastructure setup, and 50% upon full utilization of the second tranche and verified implementation. For Implementation Support Agencies (ISAs), funding is deliverable-based across pre-planning, implementation, and post-implementation phases. Van Dhan Kendras have been sanctioned Rs. 15 lakhs each, with Rs. 1 lakh per SHG of 20 members for training, equipment, and activities. Under MSP for MFP, Rs. 5 lakhs is advised to be released to VDVKs to make them primary procurement agencies.
application_process: 1. State Implementing Agency (SIA) or Implementation Support Agency (ISA) prepares project proposal in coordination with State Nodal Department (SND) and TRIFED Regional Office (RO). 2. Submit proposal to TRIFED for approval. 3. Upon approval, receive first tranche (10% for SIA, 10–20% for ISA) to initiate activities like staff deployment and awareness generation. 4. Submit Utilization Certificate (UC) and Detailed Project Report (DPR) for second tranche (40% for SIA, 30–40% for ISA) to fund capacity building, infrastructure setup, and revival of defunct VDVKs. 5. Achieve full utilization of second tranche, undergo verification, and submit supporting documents for final tranche (50% for SIA, remaining balance for ISA) to support market linkage, operationalization, and monitoring & evaluation. 6. TRIFED conducts periodic physical verifications, audits, and performance evaluations throughout the lifecycle.
required_documents: Activities plan for awareness generation and handholding support
Business plan for Level 2 and Level 3 VDPEs
Supporting documentation including progress report and field verification
implementing_agency: Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India Limited (TRIFED)

caveats: Fund release is contingent upon achievement of key implementation milestones and verified completion of deliverables
VDPEs must be formed by federating four or more geographically proximate VDVKs, with relaxation only after TRIFED review based on feasibility and justification
At least 70% of Board of Directors must be from the tribal community, and at least one-third must be women (with 50% of women from tribal community)
All direct financial assistance for working capital must be carried out only through bank account transfers
Van Dhan Vikas Kendras and SHGs must open bank accounts as per scheme guidelines
The scheme is an ongoing intervention covering 27 States and 308 Tribal pre-dominant districts under Van Dhan program and MSP for MFP Scheme
